raw_user_query: explain the definition of electromagnetic force

orchestrator_output.reformulated_query: Definition of electromagnetic force for Class 8
orchestrator_output.text_narration: Hello Sonu! The electromagnetic force is one of the fundamental forces of nature. It's the force that acts between electrically charged particles. This force is responsible for almost all the phenomena we encounter in our daily lives, like light, electricity, magnetism, and even holding atoms and molecules together to form matter. For example, when you use a magnet to pick up a pin, or when electricity flows through a wire to light up a bulb, you are seeing the electromagnetic force in action!
